description: This file defines the OAuthServer class, which provides OAuth2 server functionalities using the league/oauth2-server library. It handles initialization of OAuth server components, configuration retrieval, and grants management for authorization, refresh tokens, and access tokens within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Class managing OAuth2 authorization server setup, token configurations, and grant types for OrangeHRM's OAuth module.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes configuration and repository instances, retrieves configuration values for token TTLs and encryption keys.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the configured OAuth AuthorizationServer instance, setting up grant types.

methods.name: getAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns the Time To Live for authorization codes.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the Time To Live for refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the Time To Live for access tokens.
